environment: one host; ambient load captured, no imposed CPU stress, no physical I/O
startup: both worker imports/handshakes and offline initial arming retained separately
logging: JSONL write and flush measured; no fsync or durable-storage latency claim
memory: process peak RSS; per-session high-water mark, not per-call allocation
timing: parent monotonic intervals; worker intervals never subtracted across processes
retention: all samples, warmups, errors and timeouts; no retries or outlier removal
inference: descriptive correlated observations, no hardware generalization, energy or WCET claim
